There have been isolated reports of erythema multiforme occurring in patients given danazol. In 3 cases the reaction developed about 2 weeks after starting dana- zol, and was effectively managed by stopping danazol and treat- ing with corticosteroids.1,2 Hirsutism is a recognised adverse effect of danazol, but is usually mild. Excessive facial hair growth of sudden onset, sufficient to cause distress, has been described in a woman given danazol for mastalgia. The hirsutism improved after stopping the danazol.3 1.
